Description: Serinus Labs is a start-up spun out of UC Berkeley developing low power gas sensors for applications in automotive/industrial control and safety as well as consumer electronics for air quality monitoring. As a UC Berkeley spin-off, Serinus Labs currently leverages shared user facilities at UC Berkeley campus to conduct R&D activities for low volume prototyping. Serinus is backed by private equity investments and is also supported by the US National Science Foundation through an SBIR Phase II award. Serinus Labs comprises of 5 employees (4 full-time, 1 part-time). Serinus Labs is a Delaware C-Corp, with principal office location at 2120 University Ave, Berkeley, CA, 94704 (C/o WeWork) with a business mailing address of 1400 Shattuck Ave, Ste 12, #215, Berkeley, CA, 94709. Additionally, Serinus Labs also has a test lab site at 319 N Bernardo Ave, Mountain View, CA, 94043.
